record.question: Which world leader became the first to visit Sri Lanka after the Easter serial bombings (April 21, 2019) that left over 250 dead?
record.explanation: Answer A: Narendra Modi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Sri Lanka on 9 June 2019 after the Easter attacks; the PMO’s departure statement says the visit expressed solidarity after the attacks, and official government material later describes him as the first global leader to visit. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1573715&lang=2&reg=48; https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/E-BOOK%20-%20ENGLISH__31.5.20%20-%202%20am-1.pdf.
